messages:
Mike: quick follow-up from the postmortem. we agreed to tighten rollout defaults and add an automated containment chain. posting checklist here.
Priya: major causes recap: unscoped flag -> rapid ramp -> no local fallback. we should make the safe path the default.
Omar: agree. propose policy + infra: policy = default scope = org_tag; infra = canary detector + pause/rollback chain.
Lina: detector sketch: two-signal rule (ewma error rate over 3m, latency p95 multiplier). require 2 of 3 signals to pause canary. will prototype.
Jess: simulator: replay past incident traffic and validate thresholds. i'll own sims and gating infra.
Mike: defaults proposal: sample_pct default 1% for new flags; ramp windows [5, 15, 60] mins; cannot exceed 10% without manual approval.
Priya: SDK changes: add `fallback_variant` and `max_tokens_cap` fields per-flag so clients can immediately switch to safe behavior when paused. i'll file PR.
Omar: alerting behavior: page only on auto-rollback, slack notify on pauses. reduce noise by requiring EWMA smoothing + min evidence window.
Lina: dashboard metrics to add: canary_health_score, flag_exposure_count, pause_events, rollback_events. will mock panels.
Jess: sample guard JSON for ops/configs:
```
{"flag_id":"optimize-path-v2","scope":"org_tag","tag":"internal_beta","sample_pct":1,"ramps_mins":[5,15,60],"auto_pause":{"ewma_mins":3,"err_pct":2,"latency_mult":1.5},"auto_rollback":{"pause_mins":10}}
```
Mike: ownership: Lina -> detector + dashboard (due 2025-05-08); Jess -> simulator + gating infra (due 2025-05-05); Priya -> SDK fallback + token cap PR (due 2025-05-03); Omar -> deploy/runbook UI spec (due 2025-05-10).
Priya: policy note: require signed risk ack to opt a flag to global. add checklist item in deploy flow.
Omar: QA plan: replay incident traffic, assert canary pauses before error curve peak, confirm client fallback reduces observed errors.
Jess: staging rollout: enable `mini` canary for 3 internal tenants for 2 weeks, collect metrics, then widen opt-in.
Lina: recurring pattern detection: we'll add weekly job that scans incident history for `flag_unscoped` label; surface owners if count >1 in 90d.
Mike: ops question: how to avoid false positive rollbacks? answers: require two independent signals OR secondary metric (user-visible errors) before rollback.
Priya: i'll add unit tests ensuring CI templates default to `org_tag` scope so new flags aren't global by accident.
deploy-bot: [ci] canary-guards/basic-tests passed on staging.
Mike: good progress. i'll create the postmortem board cards and link them back to the incident ticket. next check-in in 7 days. :thumbsup:
